items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: It's in the Suzy's band. Yeah, he had the band, yeah.

ctx.x: I changed, I changed when I got here, didn't I? I was using the Wonder, wasn't I? Yeah. The Wonder was, Herbert L. Clark was his name. Oh, yeah, sure. It's in the Suzy's band. Yeah, he had the band, yeah. He made a horn that the tuning slide was in the back called a Wonder. You could hold it. And if it didn't suit your ears, all you had to do is touch it. Well, that was a cornet. Now, I changed to a Holton during the time I got a Holton, a brass Holton. I didn't keep that very long. But I bought two CG corn,…
I hope you didn't lose it all in the depression.
